description: Validate a Kimen UI spec exactly as the guarded renderer judges it, without rendering. A Kimen UI spec is JSON data, never code: {"version": 1, "actions"?: ["<name>", ...], "root": <node>}, where <node> is {"component": "<catalog tag>", "props"?: {...}, "action"?: "<declared action>", "slots"?: {"<slot>": [<node or text>, ...]}} and "" is the default slot. Returns every issue with its code, path and offending value: fix them and validate again. URL properties are refused: the surface can neither load nor open them. The authoring guide is the resource kimen://guide/ui-spec.

spec.description: The UI spec: a JSON object (or the same JSON as text). Validated by the server, so a defect comes back as named issues instead of being rejected here.

name: kimen_validate_spec
title: Validate a Kimen UI spec
